parameters.content:
## CRIT · Match payments

Signed **payment.received** events from the payment processor (payment id, reference, amount in minor units, currency, time). The reference is the invoice number. The money state of an invoice is derived from the payment and refund rows, never kept as a running total.

**Receipt** on full payment. **Review queue and alert** (REVIEW_SLACK_CHANNEL) for over-payment, payment on a paid or void invoice, wrong currency, unknown reference and payment after a refund.

**State** in the data service: the event ledger, payments (with the decision), review items, dead letters. **Retries**: 3 retries 5 s apart; writes send Idempotency-Key = payment-event:<id>:<node name> and X-Run-Id. Required steps that fail go to "CRIT · Alert on errors".

## 1. Intake and trust
Signature first (401), then the shape (400 and a dead letter), then one ledger claim per event id (409 in flight, 200 duplicate). Claimed: 202 now.

## 2. Match and record
Invoice by reference, the payments and refunds before this one, one decision, stored with the payment only while the invoice money_seq is unchanged; a run that loses reads again and decides again. A replay reads its own row back.

## 3. Receipt
Only when this payment completes the invoice. One receipt per event, keyed; recorded on the invoice.

## 4. Review
Anything ambiguous: a review item and an alert with ids and amounts.

## 5. Finish
Ledger done with the outcome; a summary item with ids only.

nodes.name: Receive payment event
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/crit/invoices/payment-events. Signed by the sender with PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET; the raw body is kept for the HMAC.

nodes.name: Verify signature
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256 over "<t>.<raw body>" from X-CRIT-Signature, constant-time compare, then the timestamp within 300 s. Nothing runs before this.

nodes.name: Route on signature
nodes.notes: Early exit: a missing, wrong or stale signature ends the run with 401 and no call of any kind.

nodes.name: Respond 401 unauthorized
nodes.notes: Answers 401 {status: unauthorized, error}.

nodes.name: Validate event shape
nodes.notes: Envelope (id, type, created_at, data) and the data of payment.received, checked before anything is stored. Amounts must be whole minor units.

nodes.name: Route by event shape
nodes.notes: valid goes on; a well-formed event of another type is ignored; a broken one is dead-lettered.

nodes.name: Respond 200 ignored
nodes.notes: Answers 200 {status: ignored}. Nothing stored.

nodes.name: Store dead letter
nodes.notes: Data service dead_letters: the payload as received, the reasons, its hash (unique, so a second delivery is not stored twice). Non-critical.

nodes.name: Respond 400 invalid

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'invalid', errors: $('Validate event shape').first().json.errors, dead_letter_id: $json.row ? $json.row.id : null }) }}

nodes.notes: Answers 400 {status: invalid, errors, dead_letter_id}.

nodes.name: Check dead letter stored
nodes.notes: After the 400: if the dead letter was not stored, the run fails into the error workflow, which alerts with the payload hash (ids only). The payload stays in the failed execution.

nodes.name: Prepare event claim
nodes.notes: Ledger claim for this payment event (scope payment_event, key = the sender's event id), with the event kept for replay.

nodes.name: Claim event
nodes.notes: Data service ledger: one claim per event id. Critical: 3 retries 5 s apart, then the error workflow.

nodes.name: Read claim result
nodes.notes: claimed goes on; in_flight means another run holds it; done means it was handled already.

nodes.name: Route on claim
nodes.notes: Early exit for in_flight (409, the sender retries later) and done (200 duplicate).

nodes.name: Respond 409 in flight
nodes.notes: Answers 409 with Retry-After: 30. Nothing else runs.

nodes.name: Respond 200 duplicate
nodes.notes: Answers 200 {status: duplicate, outcome} with the first run's outcome. Nothing else runs.

nodes.name: Respond 202 accepted
nodes.notes: Answers the processor now (202) so it does not redeliver while the payment is matched; the run continues.

nodes.name: Fetch billing config
nodes.notes: Data service config "invoice-to-payment": currencies for the amounts in the review text.

nodes.name: Find invoice by reference
nodes.notes: Data service invoices whose number is the payment reference, read first: its money_seq guards the write. Read again after a guard conflict.

nodes.name: Find payments for reference
nodes.notes: Data service payments already recorded with this reference: the state before this one, and this event's own row on a replay.

nodes.name: Find refunds for invoice
nodes.notes: Data service refunds on that invoice (a payment after a refund is a review).

nodes.name: Decide payment match
nodes.notes: exact, partial, completes, overpaid, already_paid, wrong_currency, unknown_reference, invoice_void or after_refund, from the rows before this payment. A replay reads the decision back from its own row; the same processor payment under a new event id is a duplicate. At most 5 passes.

nodes.name: Route payment match
nodes.notes: record, replay (its row is already stored: go on from it), or duplicate (nothing stored).

nodes.name: Store payment row
nodes.notes: Data service payments (unique event id and processor payment id) with the decision, only while the invoice money_seq is the one read (guard). Idempotency-Key per event and money_seq. Critical.

nodes.name: Route on payment write
nodes.notes: stored goes on; a guard conflict (another payment, a refund or a void landed first) reads the invoice again and decides again.

nodes.name: Read payment row
nodes.notes: Keeps the stored payment (or, on a replay, the row found); receipt and review flags from the decision.

nodes.name: Route on receipt
nodes.notes: A receipt goes out when this payment brings the invoice to paid in full (exact, completes, overpaid).

nodes.name: Find client for receipt
nodes.notes: Data service clients: the invoice's client, for the receipt address.

nodes.name: Prepare receipt email
nodes.notes: The Resend-shaped receipt: amount, date, reference, invoice number. A replay more than 23 hours after the payment row was stored stops the run instead (no second receipt).

nodes.name: Send receipt email
nodes.notes: Transactional email API POST /emails with Idempotency-Key per event: one receipt per payment event, also after a timeout.

nodes.name: Prepare receipt record
nodes.notes: The receipt email id and the update that records it on the invoice.

nodes.name: Record receipt on invoice
nodes.notes: Data service update on the invoice: receipt_email_id and paid_at, only while no receipt is recorded.

nodes.name: Check receipt recorded
nodes.notes: Checks the update answered with the invoice.

nodes.name: Route on review
nodes.notes: Over-payments, wrong currency, unknown reference, void invoice and payment after refund go to review. Nothing is guessed.

nodes.name: Prepare review item
nodes.notes: The review row: kind, ids and amounts. No client name, email or line text.

nodes.name: Store review item
nodes.notes: Data service review_items (unique per event and kind). Idempotency-Key per event and node.

nodes.name: Prepare review alert
nodes.notes: Slack text for the billing review channel: ids and amounts only.

nodes.name: Post review alert
nodes.notes: chat.postMessage to REVIEW_SLACK_CHANNEL. Non-critical: a failed alert is noted, the review item is already stored.

nodes.name: Check review alert
nodes.notes: Notes whether the alert went out.

nodes.name: Prepare done mark
nodes.notes: The ledger result: payment id, invoice id, match, receipt and review ids.

nodes.name: Mark event done
nodes.notes: Data service ledger: this event is done with its outcome, so a redelivery answers duplicate. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Summarize run
nodes.notes: The run's final item: event, match, ids. No client data.
